description: Conformance vectors for a2a-rust.com/hand-off. Each 'valid' value marks a hand-off ('reads' true); each 'invalid' one does not, and the task is treated as any other working task. Run by crates/a2a-protocol-types/tests/extension_vectors.rs, each value read through the SDK's own reader, and checked against the schema beside it.
carrier: Message.metadata of the task's working status message
